question: What hidden knowledge does the trailokyākarṣiṇī vidyā make accessible to its possessor?
premises: The trailokyākarṣiṇī vidyā draws even distant cosmic entities.
It brings accounts from the abode of the gods.
It reveals secrets inaccessible even to the wise.
inference: Possession of this vidyā grants access to divine and otherwise hidden knowledge.
uncertainties: Whether vṛttāntañca and rahasya are parallel objects of attraction or revelation is contextually inferred.
plain_english: And it brings accounts and secrets from the abode of the gods, unknown even to the wise.
